_comment: Manual test setups for the `!test` chat command (devcmd.rs). Each: label, about, where to go (goto: a test target kind with an optional enemy/target name and number, or playfield with an optional pos; neither = stay here), team (minifigure names, first active; optional), spawn (enemies by name around you for 15 minutes, no respawn; optional).

scenarios.label: smash
scenarios.about: 3 Crates and 3 Barrels around you where you stand (smash animation timing, loot bags)

scenarios.label: chase
scenarios.about: a Musketeer camp in Pirate World that chases you (enemy movement)

scenarios.label: boss
scenarios.about: Captain Dreadleg in the tutorial

scenarios.label: crowd
scenarios.about: 8 Pirate Corsairs around you where you stand (procs, buffs, area attacks)

scenarios.label: team
scenarios.about: Astronaut, Alien Trooper and Ballerina in the hub (animations, minifigure switching, health)

scenarios.label: kraken
scenarios.about: Crikey the Kraken's arena: he stays in the water past the floor and attacks from there

scenarios.label: darkside
scenarios.about: Planet's Dark Side, where the client hung while loading

scenarios.label: combo
scenarios.about: Roman Commander with 4 Pirate Corsairs around you (Gladius Slash combo steps, hit sparks)

scenarios.label: dialogue
scenarios.about: Video Game Guy in the tutorial: his intro dialogue starts on arrival; talk to him for the next ones (!dialog lists all)

scenarios.label: modes
scenarios.about: Hun Warrior, Classic King and Mr. Good and Evil with 4 Pirate Corsairs (specials that swap both attacks: Mount Up!, Royal Steed, Evil Potion)

scenarios.label: evil
scenarios.about: Mr. Good and Evil with 4 Pirate Corsairs (Evil Potion swaps both attacks until Good Potion)

scenarios.label: king
scenarios.about: Classic King with 4 Pirate Corsairs (Royal Steed swaps both attacks for 5 s)

scenarios.label: sandstorm
scenarios.about: Egyptian Warrior with 4 Pirate Corsairs (Sand Storm: ground ring, dust and slow on enemies)

scenarios.label: clouds
scenarios.about: Mythology cloud jumpers: the wind fan throws you up three clouds to the top in one go (jumppad.rs chains)

scenarios.label: ravine
scenarios.about: Dinosaur Rise SwampToVolcano1: across the ravine via SwampToVolcano2 to the volcano side

scenarios.label: catapults
scenarios.about: a pair of Medieval Kingdom catapults: each lands you next to the other one

scenarios.label: cannon
scenarios.about: Pirate World's cannon bricks: build it, it shoots the fort wall, the guards take you to jail (cannon.rs)

scenarios.label: lilies
scenarios.about: Mythology wind fan onto two lily pads across the water and up to the far bank (jumppad.rs: lilies throw on)

scenarios.label: portal
scenarios.about: Volcano Island, standing in the portal to Pioneer Bay: it opens only after you walked 8 m away and came back

scenarios.label: newchar
scenarios.about: a new character's team (the Roman Commander starter only) at the tutorial's first trigger (HUD portrait)

scenarios.label: mirrors
scenarios.about: the Armory's mirror puzzle (mirrors.rs): use the mirrors to bring the light to the pedestal, which opens the Thunderbolt arena's entrance; !mirrors solve|reset

scenarios.label: mirrors2
scenarios.about: the Gauntlet's mirror puzzle (mirrors.rs): light both markers by the gate to open it; !mirrors solve|reset
